philosophy: Production pragmatism: this pipeline already beat its old self 41.77→5.88 MAE on the VAI forensics case, ships certified 0.99 IoU logos, and loses to vectorizer.ai on a FINITE, AUDITED list of defect classes — staircase fallbacks, seams, dead text path, missing G2, missing ellipse primitive, half-blind symmetry, wrong colors under alpha. You do not beat a mature competitor with a new architecture; you beat it by deleting your artifact classes one per week, each behind a gate that renders both outputs and measures the difference. Every stage below is independently shippable, independently revertible, and lands in an existing function whose line number I cite. The only genuinely new discipline is Stage 0: a perceptual A/B harness against VAI's actual outputs, because today a systemic aesthetic regression passes every gate we have.
method_name: PUNCHLIST — Nine Gated Strikes (measure-first defect burn-down of the existing Hoshyari pipeline)
core_idea: The gap to vectorizer.ai is not a missing algorithm — it is the union of eight enumerable artifact classes, each of which the audit has already localized to a specific function and often to a specific constant (the IoU gate at geometry_vectorizer.py:2734-2737 that replaces valid 5-8 primitive glyphs with 29-86 staircase lines; the ≥16-crack region-graph gate at :3921-3923 that lets seams through; the linear clothoid-drift smear at :559 that breaks the clothoid family; the OFF-by-default text-safe/tiny-safe profiles). PUNCHLIST first builds the missing perceptual truth harness (render ours vs VAI's SVG, measure staircase rate, wobble, roundness, curvature-fairness, seam pixels), then executes nine surgical strikes ordered by perceptual-win-per-day, each gated by that harness plus the existing benchmark_stages.py floors. The single load-bearing insight: our worst outputs (pixel-staircase fallbacks, hairline seams) are categorically worse than VAI's worst outputs, so eliminating the bottom of our distribution buys more human-judged preference than raising the top — a refit ladder that guarantees "never ship a staircase" plus painter's-order bleed that guarantees "never ship a seam" removes the two artifact classes VAI structurally never exhibits.
pipeline:
END-STATE PIPELINE (mode `paper` becomes the only production mode; `paper-regions` machinery is absorbed, not selected):

STAGE A — INPUT & COLOR TRUTH. (1) RGBA handling: before routing, split alpha; pixels a<16 are excluded from all palette statistics (fix compact_palette in subpixel_mininet.py to take an optional validity mask), a in [16,240] marks a coverage band. Border-median alpha <128 ⇒ transparent canvas: write_svgs (:2888) drops the hardcoded white rect and emits no background. (2) Routing unchanged (JPEG→native px=1.0; lossless ≤512→MiniNet 4x). (3) After final masks exist (post-ICM, post-merge), per-region color re-estimation: color = alpha-weighted median RGB of source pixels under a 1px-eroded interior mask (cv2.erode on the region mask, fall back to full mask if erosion empties it); anchors remain the segmentation metric but stop being the shipped colors — fixes gap #9 in one afternoon, set at Region construction inside process() (:3926ff).

STAGE B — SEGMENTATION (unchanged): compact_palette → Lab argmin labeling → _icm_labels (:3579, λ=45 σ=36; also fix the np.roll wraparound by padding with edge-replicate before roll) → _merge_regions (:3628) with _enclosed_counter immunity → gradient-stack / stroke / occlusion pre-passes (:2993, :3161, :3380).

STAGE C — REGION GRAPH ALWAYS-ON. _needs_shared_region_graph (:3901) is demoted from image-level gate to per-interface policy: build the Kopf–Lischinski crack graph (region_graph.py:53 build_region_graph) whenever len(masks)≥2 and ANY shared crack exists. Interfaces with ≥4 native shared cracks are fit ONCE and reused by both incident cycles (existing region_graph.py machinery: junction pinning, corner consensus, co-circular recovery). Interfaces <4 cracks collapse to a single straight segment between their two junction pins (a 1-3px interface carries no curve evidence). Isolated regions (no non-background neighbor) keep the loop path — the stroke/loop validators the current gate protects still see them.

STAGE D — CORNERS (Sec 4) with confidence retained. Detection unchanged (hybrid CNN @0.36/@0.28, NMS 2px), but paper_corner_positions (:1114) now returns (position, p) pairs; _postprocess_corner_candidates (:1055) and _iterated_removal (:875) thread p through. Removal energy stays E=αD+R lexicographic, but acceptance of removing corner i requires E_after ≤ E_before + κ·(p_i − 0.5), κ calibrated on the V4 GT so event-F1 ≥ current 0.73 (target 0.78): confident corners resist removal, weak ones die easily. Collapse window becomes scale-aware: min(16·spacing, 0.35·loop_extent, 3.0px) when loop extent <48px, so adjacent letter corners survive (fixes gap #5).

STAGE E — FIT (Sec 5.1) with widened vocabulary and honest clothoids. fit_segment_midpoints (:1340) DP keeps the directional interval constraint verbatim; fit_sub_all (:1391) gains an ELLIPTICAL ARC candidate at r=3: Fitzgibbon direct LSQ (cv2.fitEllipse) on spans with b−a≥20 and total turn ≥25°, accuracy = same interval-straddle test using Sampson distance |F(x)|/‖∇F(x)‖ evaluated at lo_s/hi_s, end tangents from the ellipse gradient feed the existing 12 tangent bins, emission via _ellipse_curves (:62) arc slicing; dominated (skipped) when the circular arc already passed. Clothoid endpoint drift (:559 _clothoid_curves): replace the linear smear with a 2-parameter Newton on (κ0,κ1) at fixed arc length, Fresnel integrals by 16-pt Gauss–Legendre, ≤8 iterations to land the endpoint exactly; on non-convergence apply the Procrustes similarity to the whole clothoid (similarity preserves the family) — never the linear blend. Then the existing Alg-1 repair loop and _close_chain_corners/_corner_intersection (:2506) run unchanged.

STAGE F — G2 FAIRING. New _enforce_g2_joins(curves, px) after _enforce_g1_chain (:1242), applied only to loops with extent ≥48px (curvature steps are invisible below that): at each smooth join compute κ−, κ+ analytically from the supports (_support_of :2451 gives line/circle/clothoid params; cubic κ from the standard endpoint formula κ=2·cross(h1, h2−h1)·3/(3|h1|)² form). If sign(κ−)=sign(κ+) and ratio∈[1/3,3]: cubic-cubic joins are faired by re-solving the two adjacent handle LENGTHS for κ continuity at the shared point (closed-form, tangent directions untouched so G1 is preserved); arc-arc and arc-line joins get a 4px clothoid blend spanning κ− → κ+ inserted in a ±2px window. Every faired span is re-checked against its original midpoint intervals; violation ⇒ revert that join. This is defense-in-depth compatible: fairing can only ship if it stays inside the paper's own accuracy band.

STAGE G — BACKSTOP LADDER (the staircase killer). _finish_loop (:2702) keeps its three gates (bidirectional Hausdorff ≤ max(2.5, 2px+1), thick-only IoU ≥0.90, self-intersection) but on failure descends a ladder instead of jumping to _pixel_faithful_curves (:2600): RUNG 1 — re-run the fit with px_eff=1.5·px and alpha·0.5 (wider interval, cheaper breaks ⇒ more primitives allowed), corners re-detected at threshold·0.8; ship if all gates pass at original tolerance. RUNG 2 — RDP at 0.8px on the raw loop, each span fit by the existing _fit_g1_span (:242) into cubics, gates at 1.5·tolerance. RUNG 3 — floor: the current 2px resample, but Chaikin×2-smoothed BETWEEN detected corners (corners stay exact), emitted as short cubics — even the irreducible floor never shows 90° stair teeth. Rung index is appended to the template string so the harness counts ladder usage. text-safe profile (_PAPER_FIT_PROFILE) becomes the production default after the Stage-1 A/B (the audit already proved the production IoU gate is wrong on glyphs; the deviation>1.25px conjunct at :2736 is the correct guard).

STAGE H — TINY & TEXT IDEALIZATION. Tiny loops (fit_loop_paper :2759, area≤18 ∧ extent≤8): between "ellipse" and "pixel chain" insert a template tournament — {_rectangle_candidate (:96), cv2.minAreaRect rotated rect, _ellipse_candidate (:77), axis-aligned rounded-rect with one radius parameter} each scored by 4x-supersampled mask IoU; best wins if IoU ≥0.82, else _tiny_pixel_curves with one corner-preserving Chaikin pass. TEXT: glyph-run clustering piggybacks on _regularize_baselines (:2328) clusters (similar height + shared baseline + horizontal adjacency ⇒ run); each run goes to font_match.py (876 lines, working, preview-only today): on a conservative-gate pass, replace fitted loops with fontTools glyf outlines converted to cubics, per-glyph similarity transform from the tracking+affine search, then PER-GLYPH verification IoU ≥0.85 against the native mask — accepted glyphs substitute, rejected ones keep the geometric fit (mixed output is fine; VAI does exactly this "letters redrawn on top"). Substituted runs are emitted as a separate top-z layer.

STAGE I — GLOBAL REGULARIZATION (Sec 6) with the full symmetry group, then SVG. Described in the symmetry field. write_svgs (:2885): background = largest border-contact region promoted to full-canvas rect in its re-estimated color (or nothing if transparent); every path additionally carries stroke=fill, stroke-width:0.5, paint-order:stroke — a 0.25px bleed under the existing area-descending painter order makes hairline gaps geometrically impossible and 0.25px overlaps invisible; coordinates move from %.2f to %.3g. All gates: benchmark_stages.py floors + the new benchmark_vai.py perceptual meters, snapshot+revert semantics preserved.
small_images: Small icons win through four stacked changes, none speculative: (1) the tiny-loop template tournament (Stage H) finally gives a 3-8px square/diamond/rounded-rect something between 'perfect ellipse' and 'literal pixel chain' — scored on 4x mask IoU, which is the right metric at that scale because contour distance is quantization noise; (2) the backstop ladder means a 12px icon whose DP fit misses a gate gets a relaxed refit and then smooth cubics, never the 2px staircase that currently defines our worst small-icon output; (3) scale-aware corner collapse (min(16·spacing, 0.35·extent, 3px)) stops erasing the two real corners of a 6px triangle; (4) per-region color re-estimation plus alpha masking fixes the documented tiny-colour poisoning (anchors polluted by garbage under alpha=0). The existing enclosed-counter rescue and right-turn kissing-shape topology are untouched — topology stays sacred. Gate: the existing tiny_color_detail_score (with its silent except→1.0 bug fixed to propagate) plus a new 16-64px iconify probe set where the harness counts staircase primitives (target: zero) and measures roundness of loops tagged round.
text: Three layers, cheapest first. Layer 1 (config, hours): text-safe _finish_loop profile ON — the audit already proved the production IoU gate replaces valid 5-8-primitive glyphs with 29-86 staircase lines; the existing profile only falls back when deviation ALSO exceeds 1.25px, which is the correct rule. Plus tiny-safe corner policy ON and the scale-aware collapse window so adjacent letter corners (E, M, W) survive. Layer 2 (glyph-mode fitting, days): loops inside a detected text run fit with px_eff clamped ≥0.6, alpha=0.10, small CNN at 0.24 — more primitives, gentler idealization, because glyphs are the one shape class where over-simplification reads instantly as wrong. Layer 3 (font_match integration, the real prize): glyph runs found via the baseline clusters already computed in _regularize_baselines; font_match.py already implements rendering, tracking+affine search, and the 0.55·IoU+0.35·exp(−12·chamfer)+0.10·topology score with a conservative gate — the missing piece is only the substitution path: fontTools glyf→cubic conversion, per-glyph similarity placement, and a per-glyph IoU≥0.85 verification against the native mask so a wrong match can never ship (deterministic verification of an ML retrieval, exactly the project's accepted pattern). Accepted glyphs are mathematically perfect outlines — this is the only way to genuinely exceed VAI on small text, because VAI reconstructs letterforms from pixels and shows it at 12px. Failure mode is graceful: rejected glyphs keep the Layer-2 geometric fit. Gate: a 20-wordmark probe set (rasterized from the 150k-wordmark corpus at 24-64px with known font GT): zero staircase primitives, per-glyph IoU not below the geometric baseline, font-substitution precision 1.0 (no wrong-font ships) at whatever recall the gate allows.
symmetry_idealization: Replace the axis-locked _regularize_mirror (:2124) and centroid-locked _regularize_rotation (:2191) with transform voting, keeping the accuracy-budget philosophy intact. MIRROR, ANY AXIS: candidate axes come from three cheap generators — per-region PCA axes, the perpendicular bisectors of corner pairs with matching turn angles (each pair votes in a Hough space over (θ,ρ) with 2°×1px bins; peaks with ≥3 votes are candidates), and the global foreground PCA axes. Each candidate is verified by reflecting 128 arc-length-uniform boundary samples and taking the 90th-percentile nearest-neighbor residual via cKDTree: accept iff ≤0.8px (the existing budget, unchanged). Application symmetrizes rather than snaps: paired control points are averaged with their reflected partners, paired corners are made exactly mirror-images, curves crossing the axis get their axis intersection pinned. ROTATION, ANY CENTER: candidate centers = centroid (existing), circumcenter of repeated-shape instance centroids, and intersections of any two accepted mirror axes; N-fold tested 12..2 with the same 0.8px percentile-residual gate. REPEATED SHAPES UNDER SIMILARITY: drop the identical-degree-sequence requirement in _regularize_repeats (:2261) — cluster by normalized turning-function L2 distance <0.15 on 64 samples; each cluster's canonical shape is the Procrustes mean over the similarity group, refit ONCE through the full Sec-5.1 pipeline, then instanced with per-shape similarity transforms (rotation quantized to any detected N-fold, scale unified when within 2%). BOUNDING: every application runs inside the existing snapshot+revert (>3px deviation reverts, :99 in the pipeline doc), and each individual snap still obeys length·sin(dev)≤1px / vertex-move≤2px. Idealization is therefore complete over the similarity group but can never spend more than the same accuracy budget the current code already enforces — we widen the search space, not the tolerance.
artifact_elimination: SEAMS: structurally impossible after Stage C+G — every shared interface with ≥4 cracks is fit once in the always-on region graph (shared geometry cannot disagree with itself), sub-4-crack interfaces are pinned straight between junctions, and the write_svgs 0.25px paint-order:stroke bleed under painter's order covers any residual float rounding; the seam meter (supersampled render, count uncovered/miscovered pixels) gates at exactly 0. STAIRCASES: the fallback ladder makes '2px pixel polyline' unreachable — rung 3's floor is corner-preserving Chaikin cubics, and the harness counts rung usage so regression is visible; text-safe stops the IoU gate from manufacturing staircases on glyphs. WOBBLE: already largely handled by the LSQ-line + interval constraint; residual wobble on shallow curves is measured by the new curvature-sign-change meter and attacked by the ellipse primitive (patchworks of short cubics are the main wobble source) — a single elliptical arc has zero sign changes by construction. CURVATURE STEPS: Stage F G2 fairing at joins (handle-length re-solve for cubics, 4px clothoid blends for arc-arc), bounded by re-checking the original midpoint intervals so accuracy gates cannot regress; clothoid drift correction keeps clothoids actual clothoids. WRONG CORNERS (missed/spurious/misplaced): confidence-weighted removal (κ·(p_i−0.5) acceptance margin) stops the removal loop from deleting confident true corners; scale-aware collapse stops erasure of adjacent letter corners; misplacement is already handled by analytic support intersection (cap 1.5px) which stays. WRONG COLORS/BACKGROUND SHOW-THROUGH: per-region color re-estimation from eroded interiors, alpha-masked palette, background promoted to a real colored layer or true transparency.

new_components.name: benchmark_vai.py (perceptual truth harness)
new_components.what: Renders our SVG and stored VAI reference SVGs for a fixed 50-image set at 4x; computes MAE/RMSE, staircase-primitive count, fallback/ladder-rung rate, wobble (curvature sign changes per 100px), circle roundness (radial std/mean), join curvature-fairness (max |Δκ|·r at G1 joins), seam meter (uncovered/miscovered pixels). Becomes a required gate for every later stage.

new_components.name: Backstop refit ladder in _finish_loop
new_components.what: Three-rung descent (relaxed-px refit → RDP+_fit_g1_span cubics → corner-preserving Chaikin floor) replacing the unconditional pixel-staircase fallback; rung recorded in template string.

new_components.name: Always-on per-interface region graph + paint-order bleed
new_components.what: Demote _needs_shared_region_graph to per-interface policy; short-interface junction pinning; write_svgs background-layer promotion and 0.25px stroke bleed.

new_components.name: Text path: glyph-run detection + font_match substitution + glyph-mode fit
new_components.what: Baseline-cluster run detection, fontTools glyf→cubic substitution with per-glyph IoU≥0.85 verification, text-safe/tiny-safe defaults, scale-aware corner collapse.

new_components.name: G2 fairing pass + clothoid Newton endpoint solve
new_components.what: _enforce_g2_joins with handle-length re-solve and 4px clothoid blends, interval-recheck revert; Fresnel Newton (κ0,κ1) replacing linear drift smear.

new_components.name: Elliptical arc primitive (r=3) in the DP
new_components.what: Fitzgibbon LSQ candidate in fit_sub_all with Sampson-distance interval test, gradient end-tangents into the 12 tangent bins, emission via _ellipse_curves.

new_components.name: Full symmetry group detector
new_components.what: Hough axis voting + cKDTree reflection verification (any axis), any-center N-fold, similarity-group repeat unification via turning-function clustering and Procrustes-mean canonical shape; all inside existing budgets and snapshot+revert.

new_components.name: Alpha compositing + per-region color re-estimation
new_components.what: Alpha-masked palette stats, transparent-canvas output, eroded-interior alpha-weighted median color per region; fix tiny_color_detail_score silent-pass bug.

new_components.name: Confidence-threaded corner removal + one retrain
new_components.what: (position,p) plumbing through postprocess/removal, κ·(p−0.5) removal margin calibrated on V4 GT, one CNN retrain adding text-run hard negatives.

risks: No VAI reference outputs beyond the IKEA forensics case: the 50-image reference set must be produced manually once via the VAI web UI (I will not automate their site); mitigation — a one-time human batch session, references frozen in benchmarks/vai_ref/.

Always-on region graph bypasses the stroke detector and loop-level validators the current gate deliberately protects — mitigation: stroke-detected regions are excluded from the graph, and graph-fit cycles still pass through _finish_loop gates per cycle.

0.25px paint-order bleed slightly fattens topmost regions; at 0.25px it is below perceptual threshold but the seam meter must also verify no measurable area drift on the certified-logo IoU floors (Mastercard 0.9901 etc.).
font_match false positives are catastrophic for trust — the per-glyph IoU≥0.85 deterministic verification is the hard wall; precision gate is 1.0, recall is whatever survives.

G2 fairing can fight Sec-6 regularization (fairing moves handles that co-circularity just snapped) — run fairing BEFORE global regularization and re-run only the interval re-check after; revert-per-join keeps it safe but may lower its hit rate.

Confidence-weighted removal changes the calibrated F1 operating point; κ must be re-tuned against the immutable Hoshyari human layer, and a bad κ silently trades precision for recall — the event-F1 ≥0.73 floor in benchmark_stages.py is the guard.
Ellipse Sampson distance underestimates true distance at high eccentricity; clamp eccentricity ≤0.95 for the candidate to be admissible.
Schedule risk is additive, not multiplicative: every stage is independently shippable, so a stalled stage delays nothing behind it except its own win.
staged_plan: STAGE 0 (1.5d) — benchmark_vai.py + 50-image frozen VAI reference set + meters (staircase rate, wobble, roundness, fairness, seam pixels). GATE: harness reproduces the known IKEA numbers (VAI 4.66/9.95 vs ours 5.88/14.21) and runs the full set in <5 min.

STAGE 1 (2.5d) — Backstop refit ladder + text-safe default flip. GATE: ladder-floor (rung 3) usage <1% of loops on the 50-set, zero '-fallback' staircase templates, all 11 real-logo IoU floors and 12 synthetic probes in benchmark_stages.py unchanged or better.

STAGE 2 (3d) — Region graph always-on per-interface + write_svgs bleed + background promotion. GATE: seam meter = 0 uncovered pixels across the 50-set; certified logo IoUs within 0.002 of floors; Mastercard primitive count does not regress past 191.

STAGE 3 (4d) — Text & tiny path: scale-aware collapse, glyph-mode fit, tiny template tournament, font_match substitution with per-glyph verification. GATE: 20-wordmark probe: zero staircase primitives, per-glyph IoU ≥ geometric baseline, font-substitution precision 1.0; tiny probe set roundness/IoU up; corner event-F1 ≥0.73 held.

STAGE 4 (3d) — Clothoid Newton endpoint solve + _enforce_g2_joins. GATE: curvature-fairness meter improves ≥30% on the large-silhouette subset (Pepsi/Lacoste class); bidirectional Hausdorff distribution unchanged; no interval violations introduced (Alg-1 recheck clean).
STAGE 5 (2.5d) — Elliptical arc in the DP. GATE: synthetic partial-ellipse probes fit with 1-2 primitives instead of 4+ cubics; wobble meter down on those probes; DP runtime within 1.3x of baseline.

STAGE 6 (4d) — Full symmetry group. GATE: shield symmetry ≥0.98 held; new diagonal-mirror and offset-center rotation synthetic probes ≥0.98; no certified-logo revert-storm (revert rate <10% of attempted snaps).
STAGE 7 (1.5d) — Alpha + color re-estimation. GATE: flat-fill probes ship exact source colors (ΔE<1); tiny_color_detail_score (bug-fixed) ≥ current; transparent-PNG probe produces no white rect.

STAGE 8 (3d) — Confidence-threaded removal + CNN retrain with text hard negatives. GATE: event-F1 ≥0.76 post-removal (from 0.73-0.74) on the combined V4 set with the Hoshyari human layer untouched; no fit-stage regression on the 50-set. TOTAL ≈25 engineer-days; after Stage 2 the pipeline already ships no staircases and no seams, which are the two artifact classes VAI never shows.
why_beats_vai: Human preference between two competent vectorizations is dominated by worst-artifact salience: a viewer forgives a slightly soft corner but never forgives a pixel staircase, a hairline seam, or a mangled letter. VAI's forensic advantage over us today is precisely that its floor is high — everything is smooth cubics, layers complete, letters redrawn on top. Stages 1-3 raise OUR floor to structurally artifact-free (staircase unreachable, seams impossible by construction, glyphs either verified-perfect font outlines or conservatively fit), at which point the comparison moves to ceilings — and our ceiling is higher than VAI's, because we do things forensics shows VAI does not: true clothoid/G2 fairness (Stage 4) instead of generic cubic smoothing, exact idealization under the full similarity symmetry group with a hard accuracy budget (Stage 6) where VAI outputs merely near-symmetric shapes, semantic structure (one gradient fill, real strokes, completed occlusions) that survives editing, and genuine font-true small text where VAI reconstructs letterforms from pixels. Every one of these claims is falsifiable by the Stage-0 harness on the same 50 images, which is itself the deepest reason this plan wins: it is the only strategy here whose success criterion is measured directly against vectorizer.ai's actual output after every stage, on the existing codebase, with every change revertible behind the gates the team already trusts.
